title: 第3章 深蓝加点第4章 一千二百五十万
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
如果一个现代人穿越而来，就能发现他的宅院中很多现代的物件。
一开始他的想法很简单，就是在尽量低调的情况下做一个倒爷，赚他几十个小目标。
安安稳稳的做他的地主老爷和隐形富翁。
什么九九六福报自然远离他。
而今天遇到的事情，完全颠覆了他的世界观。
原来这个世界存在超凡力量！
正常的人，谁能不对超凡力量感兴趣。
朝游昆仑暮沧海的能力谁不想拥有？
倒爷可以做，超凡力量也可以去获取嘛。
“来，道长，别客气。”
顾铮给老道士倒满了酒。
老道士扫了一眼桌上的三菜一汤，色香味俱全，微微点头：“我从来不知道客气叫什么，行了，不用管我了，酒我自己倒，菜我自己夹。”
顾铮算是已经看出来了，老道士属于那种不拘小节的人，对他太客气反而令他不喜。
两人一边吃饭一边聊，他得知了老道士的一些情况。
老道士姓霍，是一个游方道士，居无定所。
吃饱喝足，霍道士慵懒的半躺着，淡淡道：“礼下于人，必有所求，说罢，有什么想法？”
“道长敞亮！”
顾铮微微拱手，直入主体：“我想拜道长为师！”
霍道士微阖双眸：“顾公子你时亨运泰，命中带紫。而修行多歧路，绝大部分时间都是枯燥的。与其踏入虚无缥缈修行路，还不如享受红尘中的富贵。”
“你这样的人我见的多了，也遇见过不少，信誓旦旦要拜我为师的，我也收过三个记名弟子，全部都没有超过三年就放弃了。”

“或许我就是那个例外呢？”顾铮沉声道。
“你？”霍道士摇摇头，而后闪电般扣住顾铮的肩膀，摸了之后道：
“你的根骨很普通，还不如我，我修行了四十年，也不敢说在修行路上有所成就，你么，恐怕会更差。”
顾铮眼神闪烁，从霍道士的话中可以断定他是有修行之法的。
或许是因为自己根骨太普通，他不愿意收。
又或者是之前的三个记名弟子半途而废太让他失望了，因此认为自己也会这样子，干脆就不收徒了。
顾铮态度坚决：“道长，如果在遇到您之前，我会甘于享受红尘富贵，可当遇到您之后，见识到了这个世界有更广阔的天地，我怎么还可能甘于困在井底仰望天空呢？”
霍道士皱眉不语。
“您怎么样才愿意收我为徒？”
“这样吧，你我相遇也算是有缘，我这里有一道驱邪符，你随身携带，可令邪祟不侵。”
霍道士取出一张黄纸符递给他，而后从包里取出一本巴掌大的古朴书籍，封面上是《食气录》一行字。
或许是觉得顾铮向道之心强烈，决定给他一个机会。
“老道我无门无派，年轻的时候科举不成，无意中进入了一个前辈的洞府，得了前辈的传承，这门练气之法，要是十五天之内能入门，就到离这里五十里之外的青云观来找我，如果十五天之内没能入门，那就不用来找我了，我们之间没有师徒缘分。”
顾铮也清楚一上来就能成功拜师是不现实的，给他留了一扇门至少还有机会，这个结果他还挺满意的。
“道长，是不是根骨就决定了一切？”
content_en:
If a modern person comes through time, he will find many modern objects in his house.
At the beginning, his idea was very simple, that is, to be a bad guy while keeping a low profile as much as possible and earn him dozens of small goals.
He can be his landlord and invisible rich man safely.
Any good fortune will naturally stay away from him.
What he encountered today completely overturned his worldview.
It turns out that there is extraordinary power in this world!
How can a normal person not be interested in extraordinary power?
Who wouldn’t want to have the ability to travel to Kunlun and the sea at dusk?
If you can do it, you can also obtain extraordinary power.
"Come on, Taoist Priest, you're welcome."
Gu Zheng filled the old Taoist priest's glass with wine.
The old Taoist priest glanced at the three dishes and one soup on the table. They were all delicious and delicious, and nodded slightly: "I never know what politeness is. Okay, don't worry about me. I'll pour the wine myself and pick up the vegetables myself."
Gu Zheng had already figured it out. The old Taoist priest was the kind of person who didn't stick to trivial matters. Being too polite to him would make him unhappy.
The two chatted while eating, and he learned something about the old Taoist priest.
The old Taoist surnamed Huo was a wandering Taoist with no fixed residence.
After eating and drinking, Taoist Huo lay down lazily and said calmly: "When you are polite to others, you must ask for something. After all, what do you think?"
"Taoist Master is bright!"
Gu Zheng slightly cupped his hands and went straight to the main point: "I want to become the master of the Taoist priest!"
Taoist Master Huo slightly closed his eyes: "Master Gu, you are always blessed with good fortune, and your destiny is purple. However, most of the time there are many different paths to practice, which are boring. Instead of embarking on the illusory path of practice, it is better to enjoy the wealth and honor in the world of mortals."
"I've seen a lot of people like you, and I've met quite a few who vowed to become my master. I also had three named disciples, but they all gave up within three years."
"Maybe I am the exception?" Gu Zheng said solemnly.
"You?" Taoist Huo shook his head, then clasped Gu Zheng's shoulder like lightning, touched it and said:
"Your bones are very ordinary, not as good as mine. I have been practicing for forty years, and I dare not say that I have achieved anything on the road of practice. You, I'm afraid, will be even worse."
Gu Zheng's eyes flickered, and it could be concluded from Taoist Huo's words that he had a way to practice.
Perhaps it was because his bones were too ordinary and he was unwilling to accept them.
Or maybe he was disappointed that the three previous registered disciples gave up halfway, so he thought that he would be like this too, so he simply stopped accepting disciples.
Gu Zheng's attitude was resolute: "Taoist Master, if I had been willing to enjoy the worldly wealth before I met you, but after I met you and saw that this world has a broader world, how could I still be willing to be stuck at the bottom of a well and look up at the sky?"
Master Huo frowned and said nothing.
"What makes you willing to accept me as your disciple?"
"Well, we are destined to meet each other. I have an evil talisman here. You can carry it with you to keep evil spirits away."
Taoist Huo took out a yellow paper charm and handed it to him, and then took out a palm-sized ancient book from his bag. On the cover was a line from "Shi Qi Lu".
Perhaps he felt that Gu Zheng had a strong desire for Taoism and decided to give him a chance.
"Old Taoist, I have no family or sect. When I was young, I failed the imperial examination. I accidentally entered the cave of a senior and received the inheritance from my senior. If you can get started with this Qi training method within fifteen days, you can come to me at Qingyun Temple, fifty miles away from here. If you can't get started within fifteen days, then there is no need to come to me. There is no master-disciple relationship between us."
Gu Zheng also knew that it was unrealistic to successfully become a disciple right from the start, so there was a door left for him to at least have a chance. He was quite satisfied with this result.
"Taoist Priest, does one's bones determine everything?"
